analysis.rationale: compression: block_boundary=1.684/2.099/2.647 (三对均>1.05, 0%FP), unique_G≈256 排除 quantization; 模拟图结构复现 bb=1.699 vs 目标 1.684 (0.9%) → jpeg:2 (sev 扫描 jpeg1/3/4/5 均更差: 离群失配或 CI/PSNR 降)。blur: gm_ratio=0.361/0.378/0.453 + glass_score=0.4575/0.74 触发 glass DT; motion (17.99dB@jpeg4), gaussian (23.63-24.50), lens (24.83) 均被 PSNR 排除; severity 结构仲裁 (同图模拟: gm_ratio 0.350 vs 目标 0.361; slope_ratio 1.168 vs 1.162; bb 1.699 vs 1.684; glass4 对应值 0.299/1.292/1.767 均更差) + PSNR 峰值扫描 (sev2 25.61 < sev3 27.93 > sev4 26.68 > sev5 24.93) → sev3; glass 为非确定性像素 shuffle, 按 SKILL 永不 LIKELY。无噪声: 剥离后 noise_prior sigma=0.99<2, extreme_pct=55% 属 JPEG/glass 伪影已知 FP; 且 x_distortion 各加性噪声最低 sigma≈12.75 远高于观测。无全局: mean_shift≤0.2, contrast_spread_ratio=0.95, saturation_ratio=0.90-0.96。三对 support 全部复核: PSNR 27.93/31.25/32.70 dB。
